notes.title: Paradise Homeland New Years Update
notes.content:
2022 Summary:

I (Josh) have been working on Paradise Homeland for over 1 year now. Time has flown by quickly. There have been 6 updates in the past year, from pets to save system updates. Even with all of these updates, Paradise Homeland still has a long long way to go before it is ready for release even into early access. I have spent over £600 of my own money on this project and I am ready to announce the 2023 road map.

2023 Road Map:
Complete Restart on project.
Clarification on specifics of the project.
Use of newer systems and purchases.
Larger Road Map Announcement.
+ Many More TBA!

Signed, 
Josh

notes.title: Perfect Pets Update ~ Paradise Homeland
notes.content:
We have pushed a new update with a pet system!

Press 'N' to access the pet menu to spawn up to 3 pets of your choice!

Press 'Z' to make the dogs sit or to make your pet stay put while you adventure somewhere else!

The new pets are; 
[list]
[*] Black Cat, 
[*] Black Wolf, 
[*] Chihuahua, 
[*] Golden Retriever, 
[*] Grey Wolf, 
[*] Great Dane, 
[*] Orange Cat,
[*] and White Cat!
[/list]
We have also updated the in-game menus with a new radial style which makes them look way better than our box style we used before!

Update Size ~ 11.80 MB

Total Size ~  635.6 MB


Thanks for reading,
Josh Elder

notes.title: Upgraded Saving System | An update on Paradise Homeland
notes.content:
We have just updated the save function. It now allows you to have multiple saves at once, making the core gameplay better than ever before!

As for the future, I will keep development up, with no promises for a release date, I will take my time, as to not get burnt out, as I have with this project and other projects.

notes.title: Development Progress Update
notes.content:
We are still developing the game, we believe we are 25% of the way until we are ready to publish the game into Alpha or also known as early access. The stuff we still need to develop are big systems, so could take a while each, from there, more furniture, more building systems, pets, clothing, and so much more. I plan on making these on a Bi-Weekly basis to keep everyone informed!

[i][u][b]Completed Development:[/b][/u][/i]
[olist]
[*] Building System
[*] Deletion System
[*] Save System
[*] Main Menu
